description: Preserve the game START TIME end-to-end in the shared data model and the backend aggregation (Issue #20 acceptance criterion 1 + 3). Today backend/src/mlb/aggregate.ts truncates the MLB Stats API `gameDate` to its date part (`game.gameDate.slice(0, 10)`), losing the start time. Add NEW OPTIONAL fields to the shared GameResult type and populate them from the full ISO UTC `gameDate`, while leaving the existing `date` field byte-for-byte unchanged for backward compatibility. Also detect and flag time-TBD games. This feature is backend + shared only; no frontend changes here.
steps: In shared/src/types.ts, extend interface GameResult with two NEW OPTIONAL fields placed after `date`: `startTime?: string;` (full ISO-8601 UTC datetime, e.g. '2024-10-01T18:32:00Z', copied verbatim from the MLB API `gameDate`) and `timeTbd?: boolean;` (true when the start time is undetermined). Do NOT change, rename, or remove the existing `date: string` field. Add a doc comment explaining: `date` stays date-only for backward compat; `startTime` carries the preserved full datetime; `timeTbd` marks a start time that is not yet scheduled. Note that both are optional so the bundled seed datasets (which omit them) and any existing producer remain valid.

In backend/src/mlb/client.ts, extend the RawGame `status` field type to include the optional `startTimeTBD?: boolean` already returned by the live MLB Stats API (confirmed present in the postseason schedule response alongside abstractGameState). Keep it optional so existing fixtures and mocks that omit it still typecheck.

In backend/src/mlb/aggregate.ts, where the GameResult is built, keep `date: game.gameDate.slice(0, 10)` exactly as-is, and ADD `startTime` and `timeTbd`. Determine timeTbd with a robust rule and document it in a code comment: timeTbd is true when `game.status?.startTimeTBD === true` OR when the parsed `gameDate` has no meaningful time-of-day (a date-only / placeholder value, e.g. the time component is exactly midnight UTC 'T00:00:00Z' which the API uses for not-yet-scheduled games). When timeTbd is true, OMIT `startTime` (leave it undefined) so the frontend renders a localized 'Time TBD' rather than a bogus midnight; when timeTbd is false, set `startTime` to the full `game.gameDate` ISO string verbatim. Implement the time-of-day detection as a small, clearly-commented helper so the midnight/placeholder rule is explicit and testable.

Extend backend/src/mlb/aggregate.test.ts: (a) update the existing `game()` fixture helper (or add fixtures) so a realistic game carries a full `gameDate` like '2024-10-01T18:32:00Z' and assert the produced GameResult has `date === '2024-10-01'` (unchanged) AND `startTime === '2024-10-01T18:32:00Z'` AND `timeTbd === false`. (b) Add a test with `status.startTimeTBD: true` asserting `timeTbd === true` and `startTime === undefined`. (c) Add a test with a date-only/midnight `gameDate` ('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') and no startTimeTBD flag, asserting the midnight placeholder is treated as `timeTbd === true` with `startTime === undefined`. Keep all other existing assertions passing (date-only `date` field unchanged).

Check backend/src/mlb/aggregate.property.test.ts still holds; if its generator produces gameDate values, ensure the new fields do not violate any invariant (add an invariant only if it is natural, e.g. 'timeTbd===true implies startTime===undefined'). Do not weaken existing invariants.

Confirm the seed JSON (shared/src/seed/postseason-2024.json, -2025.json) still parses and typechecks as Bracket with the new optional fields absent (they simply have no startTime/timeTbd). Run the shared + backend builds and tests.
acceptance_criteria: GameResult.date is unchanged (still date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD'); new optional fields startTime?/timeTbd? are added (criterion 1).
aggregateBracket populates startTime with the verbatim full ISO UTC gameDate for a timed game and sets timeTbd=false.
A game with status.startTimeTBD===true, and a game with a midnight/date-only gameDate placeholder, are both flagged timeTbd=true with startTime omitted (criterion 3).
`npm test -w @mlb/backend` passes including the new aggregation assertions; property tests remain green.
Seed datasets still parse; `npm run build` (shared + backend) succeeds with strict TS.
findings: Added optional GameResult.startTime?:string and timeTbd?:boolean to shared/src/types.ts (after `date`, with doc comments); `date` left byte-for-byte unchanged (still `game.gameDate.slice(0,10)`). Extended RawGame.status in backend/src/mlb/client.ts with optional `startTimeTBD?:boolean`. In aggregate.ts added a small commented helper hasNoTimeOfDay() (invalid-parse or exact midnight-UTC => true) and derive timeTbd = status.startTimeTBD===true OR hasNoTimeOfDay(gameDate); when TBD, startTime is omitted and timeTbd:true is set, otherwise startTime=gameDate verbatim and timeTbd:false. Used a spread so a TBD game sets only {timeTbd:true} (startTime stays undefined). Updated aggregate.test.ts game() fixture default gameDate to 2024-10-01T18:32:00Z and made it honor an injected status; added assertions (date unchanged, startTime verbatim, timeTbd=false) plus two new tests (startTimeTBD:true, and midnight placeholder) asserting timeTbd=true with startTime undefined. Added property-test invariant: timeTbd===true implies startTime===undefined. Verified: `npm run build` (shared+backend+frontend+infra) OK; `npm test -w @mlb/backend` 94 passed; `npm test -w @mlb/shared` 34 passed (seed JSON still parses as Bracket); full `npm test` green. node/npm not on PATH -> prefixed with the nvm v22.23.3 bin dir. No frontend changes (deferred to a later feature per plan). Committed as 5c82197 on feat/mlb-postseason-site.
